# bugs #4252: mcs51: the link fails after make install, because sdcc searches lib/small for mcs51.lib

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/4252/
- Category: [Fixes that need a decision](../../fix-decision.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17200
- Recommended action: Confirm that installations keep the directory names of r17128, such as lib/mcs51-large. Then apply the patch and close.
- Patch: [bugs-4252.patch](../../patches/bugs-4252.patch), commit [`77f1133bc`](https://github.com/mdmower/sdcc/commit/77f1133bc67fa8f32e58c20dbb23233c607e6a7f). Applies to r17200 without the other patches.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

After `make install` of r17200, sdcc does not link mcs51 programs unless `-L` names the library
directory. For `sdcc -mmcs51 bug.c` with the ticket's sample, the linker prints
`?ASlink-Warning-Couldn't find library 'mcs51'`, and sdcc exits with status 1. The `-k` lines of
`bug.lk` name `share/sdcc/lib/small`, and `make install` created `share/sdcc/lib/mcs51-small`.

r17200 was configured with the default prefix and with only the mcs51, z80, and stm8 ports, built
on Linux, and installed with `make install DESTDIR=<dir>`. `<dir>/usr/local/bin/sdcc` was run
without `-L`, with `SDCC_HOME` and `SDCC_LIB` unset, on a machine that did not have
`/usr/local/share/sdcc`.

## Cause

`setLibPath` in `src/SDCCmain.c`, the only caller of the port's `get_model`, appends the string
that `get_model` returns to each library path. `get_model` in `src/mcs51/main.c` returns a name
from `models[]`, such as `small` or `large-stack-auto`. The `install` rule of
`device/lib/Makefile.in` copies `build/*` to `share/sdcc/lib`, and since r17128 the rules in that
makefile build the mcs51 libraries in `build/mcs51-small`, `build/mcs51-large`, and the directories
of the other models. r17128 did not change `models[]`.

## Fix

The 16 names in `models[]` have the prefix `mcs51-`, and a comment refers to
`device/lib/Makefile.in`. The patch in the ticket's description makes the same change to the names.

## Decision

The patch changes the compiler and keeps the directory names of r17128. In trunk, the source and
build directories in `device/lib` and `LIBDIR` in the regression `spec.mk` files have these names,
and other ports have library directories such as `stm8-large` and `pdk15-stack-auto`. With the
patch, sdcc searches `$SDCC_LIB/mcs51-large` where r17200 searches `$SDCC_LIB/large`, and users
must change `-L` options that name a directory from before r17128, such as `lib/large`.

The alternative is to keep `models[]` and to make the `install` rule copy each
`build/mcs51-<model>` directory to `lib/<model>`. Installations then keep the names from before
r17128, and the build tree and the installation have different names.

## Verification

The patch does not add a regression test, because the regression suite gives the linker the library
directory with `--nostdlib` and `-L`. Three trees were installed and run as in the Finding: pristine
r17200, r17200 with the patches that precede this one in the series, and that tree with this patch.

In the first two trees, the ticket's sample does not link, and `sdcc --print-search-dirs` prints
library directories without the prefix for the four models with and without `--stack-auto` and
`--xstack`. A second program, which needs the library's `int` division, `long` multiplication, and
`float` routines, does not link in the four models or with `--stack-auto` in the small and large
models. These are the six option sets that have a library.

With the patch, the directories that sdcc prints have the prefix, the ticket's sample links, and
the second program links in the six option sets. Its map files name `mcs51.lib` in the six
`lib/mcs51-*` directories, and in the installation's `ucsim_51` it stores the correct bytes
`01 01 01 5a`. The regression suite passes for the host and the six mcs51 variants. A build with
all ports was not tested, and the Windows installer was not built.

## Related

`support/scripts/sdcc.nsi` names the mcs51 library directories without the prefix, such as
`lib\small` and `lib\large-stack-auto`, and the source directory `lib\src\mcs51`. `make install` of
r17200 does not create these directories, and the patch does not change the script.
